en-US.name: Contextify
en-US.subtitle: Session Manager for Developers
en-US.promotional_text: Track your Claude Code sessions with real-time AI summaries. Never lose context across conversations.
en-US.description:
Stop losing track of AI coding conversations. Contextify monitors your Claude Code and Codex sessions, generates intelligent summaries, and organizes every project automatically.

⚡ KEY FEATURES

• Real-time Session Tracking – Never manually refresh. See every conversation update instantly, even mid-message.
• AI-Powered Summaries – Get intelligent recaps at a glance. Understand conversation flow without re-reading everything.
• Project-Centric Organization – Switch between projects instantly. Contextify automatically organizes every session, no setup required.
• Timestamped Artifacts – Every interaction creates a timestamped Markdown record. Review any past conversation anytime.
• Drag & Drop Ingestion – Drop files or URLs directly to create instant artifacts. No copy-paste needed.
• Session Checkpoints – Mark important moments in your development workflow with one click.
• Timeline Visualization – See your entire conversation history with visual timeline navigation. Jump to any point instantly.
• Git Integration – Automatically tracks git repository context for each session. Know exactly which branch you were working on.

🎯 PERFECT FOR

• Software developers using AI coding assistants daily
• Teams maintaining context across multiple AI-assisted projects
• Developers who need to review and reference past AI interactions
• Anyone wanting organized, searchable Claude Code conversation history

💡 HOW IT WORKS

Contextify runs as a lightweight native macOS HUD that monitors your ~/.claude/projects/ and ~/.codex/sessions/ directories. When you start a conversation with Claude Code or Codex, Contextify automatically detects it, tracks the conversation timeline in real-time, and generates intelligent summaries using advanced LLM processing.

All data is stored locally in a SQLite database with full support for custom locations (Dropbox, iCloud Drive). Your conversations remain private and under your control—nothing leaves your Mac.

🔒 PRIVACY & SECURITY

• All data stored locally on your Mac—never transmitted to external servers
• No cloud sync, no analytics, no tracking
• Security-scoped bookmark system for safe file access in sandboxed builds
• Full control over your conversation data with exportable Markdown artifacts

🛠 TECHNICAL DETAILS

• Built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI for native macOS performance
• Lightweight background monitoring with minimal CPU impact
• Real-time file system monitoring using FSEvents
• GRDB SQLite backend for fast queries and efficient storage
• Support for custom database locations (local, Dropbox, iCloud Drive)
• Universal binary for both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs

📊 SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

• macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later
• Claude Code or Codex CLI installed and configured
• 50 MB free disk space (database grows with conversation history)

Download Contextify today and never lose context again. Join developers building better software with AI coding assistants. All data stays private on your Mac—try it risk-free.

review_information.notes:
Contextify monitors Claude Code and Codex CLI conversation transcripts. To fully test the app:

1. Install Claude Code CLI (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code)
2. Run 'claude' command to start a session
3. Launch Contextify - it will auto-detect the active session
4. The app will display real-time conversation timeline and summaries

The app requires access to:
• ~/.claude/projects/ (Claude Code transcripts)
• ~/.codex/sessions/ (Codex transcripts)

These are standard locations for AI coding assistant conversation logs. No special permissions needed beyond standard file access.

You'll be prompted for permission to these directories, the app uses security-scoped bookmarks prescribed in the docs to access these directories.

data_collection.data_usage: All data is stored locally on the user's Mac. No data is transmitted to external servers. Contextify only reads conversation transcripts from Claude Code and Codex CLI directories on the local filesystem.

specifications.description: Hero shot: Main HUD window showing active conversation timeline with project info, real-time entries streaming in, and AI-generated summary visible. Show clean, professional UI with Contextify logo. Background should be a typical developer desktop with terminal/code editor visible but blurred. Emphasize the floating HUD nature of the app.

Timeline visualization: Full conversation timeline showing multiple entries with timestamps, user messages, assistant responses, and tool calls. Highlight the chronological flow and easy navigation. Show the search/filter functionality if available. Include visual indicators for different entry types (user, assistant, tool).

Project management: Show the project switcher interface with multiple projects listed. Display project names, git branches, last activity timestamps. Demonstrate how users can easily switch between different coding projects. Show at least 3-4 different projects with recognizable names.

AI-powered summaries: Close-up of an LLM-generated conversation summary. Show the summary text clearly with professional formatting. Highlight how the summary captures key discussion points, decisions made, and action items. Include timestamp and context info. This should demonstrate the AI intelligence of the app.

Drag & drop demonstration: Show the drag & drop zone active with a file being dragged over the HUD. Include visual feedback (highlight, drop zone indicator). Show the resulting artifact creation with Markdown preview. This demonstrates the file ingestion feature.

Settings & customization: Display the settings panel showing database location options (including Dropbox/iCloud Drive support), appearance preferences, and monitoring settings. Show the professional settings UI with clear options. This demonstrates advanced configuration capabilities.

Git context awareness: Show how Contextify displays git repository information - branch name, commit hash, repository path. Display this integrated into the conversation context. Demonstrate the automatic git detection feature.

Overview preview (30s): Open with Contextify logo, then show a developer launching Claude Code in terminal. Cut to Contextify automatically detecting the new session. Show real-time entries appearing in the timeline as the conversation progresses. Demonstrate quick project switching. Show an AI summary being generated. End with tagline 'Stay in Context with Contextify'. Use smooth transitions, no hands/cursor visible unless necessary. Background music: subtle, tech-focused.

Feature showcase (25s): Quick feature montage: 1) File drag & drop creating artifact (3s), 2) Timeline navigation and search (4s), 3) Checkpoint creation (3s), 4) AI summary generation (5s), 5) Git integration showing branch context (4s), 6) Settings with database location options (3s), 7) Multiple projects organized (3s). Fast-paced, energetic. Each feature should be clearly labeled with text overlay. No narration needed.
